title: Successor trace decomposition
statement: Let $r,k,s$ be natural numbers with $r>0$, and let a nonempty finite set of vertices be given in a $2r$-partite vertex set. Pairing traces of length $s+1$ are equivalent to pairs consisting of a partner choice from the vertices in parts other than the pivot's part and a pairing trace of length $s$ on the set remaining after removing the pivot and that partner.
hypotheses_covered: The remaining vertex set is nonempty
